name: themeguard
description: Audits a project's CSS colour variables: value collisions between roles, dead tokens, and ramps that collapse between themes.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

//: 0.1.0 is the first release with something to run: `themeguard <file.css>` audits a stylesheet from a terminal, and the library is importable via the exports map. The tarball ships dist/ only — src/ and tests/ (including the 96 KB vendored calibration fixture) are development assets and stay out of it.
